title: Greatest Mysteries Ever
description:
The Ten Plagues: A Greek Curse?
The ten plagues of Egypt are supposedly sent by God to convince Pharaoh to free the Israelites; some scientists link these events to a volcanic eruption or climate change; could these be natural occurrences or are they divine warnings?

title: Greatest Mysteries Ever
description:
Ancient Rome: Fall or Pushed?
The Roman Empire fell in the year 476, yet questions linger; did it truly fall or does it continue as the Byzantine Empire? What caused its demise? The debate remains controversial even among modern historians.

title: Greatest Mysteries Ever
description:
Mary Magdalene: First Apostle
Mary Magdalene appears twelve times in the Gospels yet remains a controversial figure; this exploration examines the wide variety of depictions and the limited historical facts known about her.

title: Greatest Mysteries Ever
description:
Tutankhamun: Lifting the Curse
Tutankhamun, Egypt's teenage pharaoh, leaves an enduring legacy in the 10 short years he ruled; given questions surrounding his untimely death, Tutankhamun remains one of history's enigmas.

title: Greatest Mysteries Ever
description:
Ramses II: The Greatest Pharaoh
Rameses II led Egypt through a sixty-year golden age as a powerful pharaoh; despite his recorded achievements, researchers investigate lingering mysteries regarding his wife Nefertari and his death.

title: Greatest Mysteries Ever
description:
El Dorado: Gold, Guns and Greed
El Dorado, the legendary city of gold, captivated Europeans in the 16th and 17th centuries, sparking endless quests for hidden treasures; fueled by greed, these expeditions led to the loss of countless lives.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned: Hidden America
description:
S03 E07 — The Aviatrix's Sanctuary
Learning why a radical religious group went to war with a Pacific Northwest town; exploring a wartime detention center in Wyo.; visiting a criminal sanctuary on Florida's Gulf Coast; exploring at the so-called Strangest House in the World.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned: Hidden America
description:
S03 E01 — The Cult of Antelope, Oregon
A rural town in Oregon is invaded by an eccentric cult, a battered building in Florida plays a major role in the cigar trade, and a junkyard palace in New Jersey becomes the subject of controversy and rumors of the supernatural.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned: Hidden America
description:
S04 E07 — The Lair of the Mothman
A desert facility trains a nuclear strike force; a church becomes a sanctuary from racial violence; an old military building spawns a creature that haunts a small town.

description:

description:

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S01 E07 — Mystery Space Squid
A NASA astronaut reports seeing a flying saucer in the skies above a U.S. Air Force test range; how the swirling gases of Saturn have formed a perfect hexagon that has hovered above the planet's pole for 30 years.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S09 E05 — Curse of the White Dwarf
White dwarfs are small, dead stars with a dangerous side, and they are capable of exploding into supernovas and destroying planets; new research suggests these mysterious phenomena may be the key to understanding the universe itself.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S09 E02 — Mission to a Comet
The Rosetta mission is a groundbreaking expedition to land on a comet for the very first time; special access reveals what this cutting-edge journey discovers and how these mysterious objects help create life on Earth.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S11 E03 — Most Violent Event in the Universe
The collision of two supermassive black holes is the most violent event that can occur in the universe; experts explore where a black hole's energy originates and what really happens when the two most powerful objects in the cosmos clash.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S05 E02 — Ghosts of the Berlin Wall
Shocking secrets were revealed when the Berlin Wall finally came down.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S05 E06 — Secret Societies: Mystery and Conspiracy
Experts investigate if there's any truth to conspiracy theories that allege secret societies control the course of world history from behind the scenes, and if true, new discoveries might finally reveal the extent of their global domination.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S05 E03 — Hunt for Nazi Treasure
Experts investigate the fate of billions of dollars in gold and artwork that Adolf Hitler stole during World War II; using brand-new discoveries, the location of the missing Nazi treasure could be located.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S05 E04 — Secret History of James Bond
James Bond is one of the famous characters in history, and new discoveries reveal there might be a secret truth behind this famous figure; experts team up with a former spy to separate fact from fiction and reveal the secrets of modern espionage.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S05 E05 — The Dead Sea Scrolls Conspiracy
Experts investigate if there's a conspiracy surrounding the Dead Sea Scrolls, the ancient texts that the Vatican kept top-secret for decades, which could reveal the location of a mysterious tunnel holding billions of dollars of treasure.

title: Forbidden History
description:
S05 E01 — Secret History of Jesus
New investigations into the mysterious life of Jesus Christ reveal the truth behind this history-changing figure; using the latest evidence, experts try to separate fact from fiction.

title: What on Earth?
description:
S04 E17 — Hunting the Ark of the Covenant
New discoveries lead investigators to a crypt rumored to hold the Ark of the Covenant; when a great white shark is killed, experts suspect a mysterious ocean monster; strange markings in the desert might be a tribute to an ancient spider god.

title: What on Earth?
description:
S04 E18 — Forbidden City of Inca Gold
Treasure hunters have searched for a lost Incan city of untold wealth for a century, but new technology might finally locate its riches; a strange mountain in Egypt sparks an investigation into Cleopatra's gems and the tomb of Alexander the Great.

title: What on Earth?
description:
S04 E13 — North Korea's Forbidden Islands
Man-made islands appear near a North Korean missile facility; an unexpected find in a remote desert leads experts to a lost city of giants; a strange discovery in Siberia suggests a secret mission to the center of the Earth.

title: What on Earth?
description:
S04 E14 — Cannibals in the Ghost City
An abandoned city in the African jungle may be haunted by the malevolent spirits of cannibals; Mount Vesuvius shows signs of an awakening, and the mafia could be to blame; experts investigate Adolf Hitler's secret Nazi UFO program.

title: What on Earth?
description:
S04 E15 — Curse of Medusa
Researchers investigate a strange glowing lake reported to turn things into stone; a structure in Africa that resembles Stonehenge is said to be the resting place of a mythical giant.

title: What on Earth?
description:
S04 E16 — Nazi Stonehenge
A mysterious Stonehenge-like structure in Russia may have links to the Nazis; experts uncover clues to a megatsunami with the power to devastate the United States; a huge lake appears in the Sahara overnight.

The team joins forces, placing popular sayings under the microscope to determine whether it really is "impossible to polish a turd," possible to "hit the ground running" or advisable to "end with a bang."

title: Mummy Unexplained Files
description:
S01 E03 — Tut's Darkest Secret
Cutting-edge science reveals new discoveries about the mutilated mummy of a young woman with a secret link to Tutankhamun; as experts use modern-day criminal forensics to follow fresh leads, the bloody trail leads straight to the Boy King.

title: Mummy Unexplained Files
description:
S01 E05 — Pharaoh of Niagara Falls
Leading scientists and Egyptologists use state-of-the-art forensics to investigate the Niagara Falls mummy and search for its true identity; how a legendary ancient Egyptian pharaoh ended up on the other side of the world.

title: Mummy Unexplained Files
description:
S01 E01 — The Screaming Mummy Conspiracy
The horrifying remains of the Screaming Mummy have haunted archaeologists for decades, but experts uncover new evidence to reveal the treacherous conspiracy that led to the mummy's grisly end.

title: Mummy Unexplained Files
description:
S01 E04 — Egypt's Lost Queen
A brand-new discovery inside a 3,000-year-old treasure chest may lead experts to the Egyptian pharaoh who was erased from history: a woman named Hatshepsut, who was one of the most controversial and successful pharaohs of all time.

title: Mummy Unexplained Files
description:
S01 E06 — To Kill a King
The mysterious mummy of Ramesses V reveals a shocking tale of bitter family rivalry, civil insurrection and a cause of death that ultimately pushed Ancient Egypt to the edge of collapse.

title: Ancient Unexplained Files
description:
S01 E04 — War of the Ancients
An archaeological excavation uncovers ancient human carnage; experts use 3D modeling to reveal what may be the first major war in human history.

title: Ancient Unexplained Files
description:
S01 E08 — Tomb of the Red Queen
In an abandoned Maya city, an archaeologist discovers the tomb of a mysterious red skeleton decorated in jade and pearl treasures; experts use cutting-edge tech to reveal who this person was and why they were buried so.

title: Ancient Unexplained Files
description:
S01 E03 — Secrets of Skull Grave
Archaeologists excavating a historic Chilean site make a chilling discovery and find decapitated human skulls separate from a nearby burial site; experts use advanced cranial forensics to reveal what happened to these ancient, butchered victims.

description:
S08 E02 — Rome's Gate to Hell
According to legend, the ancient Roman city of Hierapolis hides a secret portal to the underworld beneath its streets; armed with pioneering technology, archaeologists gain rare access to investigate the deadly truth behind these hellish myths.

title: Unearthed
description:
S08 E03 — Legend of King Midas
King Midas and his legendary golden touch is one of the most famous tales in Greek mythology; using advanced archaeological methods, experts travel deep inside mysterious ancient mounds to investigate the truth behind the myth.

S08 E09 — Sumerian Pyramid of Death
Deep in the Iraqi desert, a ziggurat towers over the remains of the first civilization ever known in human history; armed with pioneering satellite imagery, experts investigate the dark mysteries behind the ancient structure.

The Pantheon is a 2,000-year-old temple with a secret; using cutting-edge archaeological methods and brand-new evidence, experts look beneath the streets of Rome to find out why it was built and how it survived so long.
